rules.rule: Never hardcode API keys, tokens, secrets, or private keys. Use environment variables (process.env) or GitHub Secrets. Flag any string matching patterns like 'sk-...', 'S...' (Stellar secret keys), JWT secrets, or DigitalOcean tokens.
Stellar secret keys (starting with 'S') must NEVER appear in source code, comments, or test fixtures. Use environment variables only. Test fixtures should use clearly documented test-only keys.

Avoid console.log, console.error in production code paths. Use structured logging (pino for backend, Sentry for error tracking). console methods are acceptable only in scripts/, CLI tools, and explicit debug utilities.
All async operations must have proper error handling with try/catch or .catch(). Use shared/errorCodes.js for consistent error responses. Never swallow errors silently.
All user inputs must be validated before processing. Use Zod schemas for runtime validation. Sanitize inputs to prevent injection attacks (SQL injection, XSS, path traversal).
API endpoints handling payments, auth, or sensitive operations must implement rate limiting. Use the express-rate-limit middleware with Redis store. Check existing patterns in the codebase.

Soroban/Rust contracts must use checked arithmetic (checked_add, checked_mul, etc.), avoid unbounded loops, and use ContractError instead of raw panic!. All public contract methods must validate inputs and check authorization.
Use parameterized queries with Knex.js. Never concatenate user input into raw SQL strings. All database queries must go through the Knex query builder or use bindings.

TypeScript code must use proper types. Avoid 'any' unless absolutely necessary with a comment explaining why. Use interfaces/types for all function parameters and return values. Leverage the @finchippay/sdk types for API interactions.
UI components must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Use semantic HTML, proper ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation support, and sufficient color contrast. Run axe-core checks.
All user-facing strings must use the i18next translation framework (useTranslation hook, t() function). Never hardcode English strings in UI components. Check i18n:check passes.

Terraform resources must use variables (no hardcoded values), have proper tags (project + env), use consistent naming with the local.name_prefix convention, and include descriptions for all variables and outputs.

Kubernetes manifests must set resource requests/limits, use non-root users, avoid privileged containers, use readOnlyRootFilesystem where possible, and reference secrets via secretKeyRef (never inline).
New features must include unit tests. Bug fixes must include regression tests. Use Jest for JS/TS, cargo test for Rust. Test files should be in __tests__/ or co-located as *.test.{ts,js,rs}.
Dockerfiles must use multi-stage builds, pin base image versions, minimize layers, use .dockerignore, and never include secrets in build args. HEALTHCHECK should be included.
CI workflows must use pinned action versions (e.g., actions/checkout@v4 not @main), define proper permissions, avoid shell injection in run steps, and use secrets contexts (never hardcoded tokens).
